user_authority: Coordinator adopted the bounded plan after independent reviews; source checkpoint was verified before one supervised execution window.
rules: Prospective IDs do not identify completed experiments.
Historical prospective entries are now linked to retained actual records; no incomplete gate is promoted to a pass.
Literature motivates design choices; thresholds are analyst choices and numerical reference is not physical truth.

Control command hashes and branch signatures
entries.failure_outcome: Stop and retain exact offending inputs; do not infer an exact crossing time.
outcomes: Both saved-path endpoint preflights passed, including command hashes. No continuous crossing exclusion or physical validation follows.

entries.question: Does the same on-manifold model with a documented geometry extension pass the joint-stage self-consistency screen?

entries.acceptance_origin: PLAN.md section 7; all numerical caps and 0.6 factor are analyst-designed.
outcomes: All six J runs completed; both prescribed joint self-consistency screens passed. Differences are floor-limited, so these results do not measure asymptotic order or error against physical truth.
